AI Safety Expert Warns of Existential Risk from Advanced Artificial Intelligence

An Anthropic researcher has raised concerns about the potential existential risks posed by advanced artificial intelligence, stating there is a greater than 10% chance AI could "kill all humans" within the next decade. The researcher, identified as the Alignment Lead at Anthropic, expressed worries that AI systems capable of self-improvement are developing faster than anticipated. This warning highlights the accelerating pace of AI development and the potential for unforeseen consequences from increasingly sophisticated AI.
